question: In which Indian state is the 'Garia' dance traditionally performed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripura**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

__ 
 
• The **Garia dance** is a traditional folk dance of the northeastern Indian state of **Tripura**. 
 
• It is performed during the **Garia Puja**, a festival celebrated by the tribal communities of Tripura to honor the deity **Garia**, believed to bring prosperity and good harvest. 
 
• The dance is usually performed during the months of **March and April**, which coincide with the agricultural season and the Bengali New Year. 
 
• The dance involves vibrant costumes, traditional tribal musical instruments such as the **khamb (drum)** and flutes, and rhythmic movements that depict the cultural richness and unity of the tribal people. 
 
• The Garia dance is a collective performance, symbolizing the spirit of community and the connection between humans, nature, and the divine. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 

__ 
 
• **Garia Puja:** 
 
 
• **Garia Puja** is one of the most important festivals for the tribal communities of Tripura, such as the **Tripuri, Reang, Jamatia,** and others. 
 
• It is dedicated to the deity **Garia**, who is believed to control livestock, wealth, and crops. 
 
• The festival involves the offering of **chicken, rice, eggs, cotton thread, rice beer, and bamboo** to the deity. 
 
• The rituals are performed by a tribal priest, and the festival lasts for about a week. 
 
 
 
• **Significance of Garia Dance:** 
 
 
• The dance signifies **gratitude towards nature** and the divine for a good harvest. 
 
• It also fosters **social bonding** and cultural unity among the tribal communities. 
 
 
 
• **Traditional Costumes and Instruments:** 
 
 
• Performers wear traditional tribal attire made of handwoven fabrics, adorned with **beads and ornaments**. 
 
• The instruments used include the **khamb (drum), bamboo flutes, and cymbals**, adding a rhythmic and melodic touch to the dance. 
 
 
 
• **Other Cultural Dances of Tripura:** 
 
 
• Besides Garia, Tripura is also known for other traditional dances such as **Hozagiri Dance** (performed by the Reang community) and **Lebang Boomani Dance**. 
 
• These dances are deeply rooted in the tribal culture and reflect their close association with nature. 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 

 
 
• **Tripura:** Tripura is one of the **Seven Sister States** in northeastern India, known for its rich tribal heritage and biodiversity. 
 
• **Tribal Population:** Around **31%** of Tripura's population comprises tribal communities, making their festivals and dances significant cultural markers. 
 
• **Recognition:** Efforts have been made to preserve and promote tribal dances like Garia at state and national cultural events.
